create_MLP_classifier: create an MLP classifier with a given number of input features, output features, and hidden layers
build_MLP_network: build a multi-layer perceptron network using PyTorch nn.Linear and nn.ReLU activation layers
run_MLP_forward: run the forward pass of an MLP classifier on input tensor data
review_MLP_init: review the MLP class constructor to understand how layers are built from in_features, out_features, and nlayers
refactor_MLP_layers: refactor the MLP class to customize the number of hidden layers or add dropout regularization
